記.meaning: A <part>cobra</part> sways at the foot of the king's throne. As the king makes his <part>speech</part>, it scratches every word into the sand with the tip of its tail, never missing one. It's the royal <kanji>scribe</kanji>.
記.on: When the speech ends, it locks the words in a chest and swallows the <sound>key</sound>.
記.kun: A <sound>shee</sound>p reads it all aloud, while a <sound>roo</sound>k copies it onto paper: written down.

籍.meaning: At the oldest farm school, each new student carves her name on a strip of <part>bamboo</part>, ties it to a rusty <part>plough</part> from <part>antiquity</part>, and drags it once round the field. Now her name is on the list for good. That's how you <kanji>enroll</kanji>.
籍.on: The field is split like a pie chart, one <sound>sec</sound>tor ploughed for each new class.

義.meaning: A wolf with a huge <part>ego</part> struts into the meadow and eats the flock's grass. One small <part>sheep</part> stands up, marches him to the village court and makes him plant it all back, blade by blade. Right beats might: that's <kanji>justice</kanji>.
義.on: The court clock ticks on, every <sound>gea</sound>r turning, as the wolf digs.

反.meaning: A grumpy <part>pretzel</part> lives under a <part>cliff</part> and disagrees with everything. Say up, it says down. Say twist, it untwists. It even waves a tiny banner that just says NO. It's <kanji>anti</kanji> everything.
反.on: Offer it <sound>hon</sound>ey and it demands mustard instead.
反.kun: It even bends over backwards on the arm of a <sound>so</sound>fa, just to be different: warped.

備.meaning: Before climbing the <part>cliff</part>, a hiker takes rope and boots off a <part>coat hook</part>, packs a tuft of <part>grass</part> for her goat, and leans a <part>fence</part> panel on the rock as a ladder. Rope, boots, snack, ladder: she knows how to <kanji>equip</kanji> a climb.
備.on: A <sound>bee</sound>tle rides along in her pocket as a lucky charm.
備.kun: The night before, she lays it all out on the <sound>so</sound>fa, with a packed lunch of <sound>na</sound>an.

準.meaning: A <part>sparrow</part> fills its birdbath with <part>water drops</part>, one beakful at a time, and checks the mark painted on the side: <part>ten</part> means full. It stops at five, hops in and splashes about anyway. Half full is still a bath: a <kanji>semi</kanji>-bath.
準.on: Afterwards it dries its wings in a prickly <sound>jun</sound>iper bush.
準.kun: Its chicks copy every move in the <sound>jun</sound>iper, splash for splash.

次.meaning: A bored penguin queues on the <part>ice</part> and lets out a huge <part>yawn</part>. At last the ticket man points his way: you're up. 'Who's <kanji>next</kanji>?' he calls, and the penguin waddles forward.
次.on: It climbs into a muddy <sound>jee</sound>p for a ride across the ice.
次.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' sneezes the next in line, a goose with a gaggle of <sound>gee</sound>se behind it.
